excerpt: Skydio builds autonomous drones and docks for public safety, infrastructure inspection and defence. It raised $110M at a $4.4B valuation in April 2026.
content:
Skydio is a US maker of autonomous drones. Its aircraft use onboard AI and cameras to fly themselves, avoid obstacles and complete missions with little piloting skill required. Its website organises the business around Drone as First Responder (DFR) programmes for police and fire departments, physical security, inspection of assets such as substations, bridges and oil and gas sites, surveying and mapping, and national security. Its products include the X10 and X10D drones, the R10 for indoor flights and Skydio Dock, a rooftop base that lets a drone launch and recharge automatically.

Crunchbase News reported that Skydio was founded in 2014 and that Adam Bry is its co-founder and CEO. The company sold consumer drones in its early years but left the consumer market in 2023 to focus on enterprise, public safety and defence customers, DroneXL reported. Its drones are used across the US Department of Defense; in 2026 DroneXL reported a $52 million US Army order for X10D drones.

Funding

Skydio raised a $230 million Series E in February 2023 led by Linse Capital, at a $2.2 billion valuation, according to Crunchbase News; investors in that round included Andreessen Horowitz, Nvidia and Axon. On 23 April 2026 it announced a $110 million Series F at a $4.4 billion post-money valuation. DroneXL reported that Skydio says it has shipped more than 60,000 drones, flown 3.7 million customer missions, serves more than 3,800 enterprise customers and 1,200 public safety agencies, and earns hundreds of millions of dollars in annual revenue; those figures come from the company.

Pricing

Skydio does not publish prices on its website. Agencies and companies buy through its sales team and resellers, usually as a package of drones, docks and software.

We have not flown Skydio drones. This page is based on Skydio's website and announcements and on Crunchbase News and DroneXL reporting.
